# Quality, Health & Safety

> MENASCO delivers electro-mechanical and MEP contracting services across the UAE, built on quality management, health and safety, and engineering excellence, governed by an integrated QHSE system certified to ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and ISO 45001:2018.

## QHSE Framework

As a mechanical contracting and MEP engineering company operating across the UAE, MENASCO continually works to ensure our electro-mechanical services and the quality of our work meet the highest standards in the construction industry. Every process we run is governed by an integrated management system certified to ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and ISO 45001:2018, internationally recognized standards for Quality, Health, Safety, and Environmental (QHSE) management.

We are committed to protecting the health and wellbeing of our employees, partners, clients, and the communities where we work. Through proactive risk management, continuous improvement, and strict adherence to QHSE principles, we minimize health, safety, environmental, and operational risks across every activity, product, and service we deliver.

## Certifications

- ISO 9001:2015, Quality Management Systems
- ISO 14001:2015, Environmental Management Systems
- ISO 45001:2018, Occupational Health & Safety Management Systems

Certificate numbers and issue dates are not publicly published.
